title: Combining Closing Cost Credits on One Loan File
content:
**Larkspur Closing Cost Credit — Credit Program Policy, credits on the same loan file**

1. **Reading the file.** Credits on the same loan file are read together: the credits on that file whose status is reserved, verified or applied, each with its program.
2. **One per program.** A loan file may carry only one credit of each program in reserved, verified or applied status. Whether the file already carries such a credit is taken from Larkspur's own credit records for that loan file and that program, as they stand before the reservation is made; a customer's statement does not stand in for those records.
3. **At most 3.** A loan file may carry at most 3 credits in reserved, verified or applied status.
4. **Mutual listing and exclusive groups.** Two credits may sit on one loan file only when each program lists the other among the programs it may be combined with. Two programs of the same exclusive group, other than none, never combine: a file holding the Larkspur Neighborhood Access Grant cannot also hold the Larkspur Neighborhood Access Grant Plus, and a borrower who qualifies for both is offered the Plus.
5. **Buydown subsidy.** A Larkspur Builder Partner Credit may pay a buydown subsidy only when the loan file also carries a temporary or permanent buydown.
6. **Payment at closing.** At closing the borrower's costs are covered first by the seller and agent concessions recorded on the loan file, then by the credits in ascending order of each program's application position. Each credit fills its applicable cost categories in the listed order up to the cost still unpaid in that category. That clause is **no longer in force** only for the nonrecurring closing costs and the down payment of a Larkspur Neighborhood Access Grant, whose entries are sized by that grant's closing-cost and down payment rules; every other credit, and every other cost category of a Larkspur Neighborhood Access Grant, still fills its applicable cost categories in the listed order up to the cost still unpaid in that category. A credit never pays a cost another source has already paid, and the sum of every concession and credit on the Closing Disclosure never exceeds the borrower's total closing costs, prepaid items and, for credits that allow it, down payment.
7. **Unused credit.** Unused credit is forfeited and never paid out in cash.

The application position and the exclusive group of each program are program figures of the Closing Cost Credit.

### Points of judgement (hypothetical file)

A loan file carries a verified credit of program A and a reserved credit of program B; a third program C is proposed.

- Program C cannot sit on the file if C and A do not each list the other, or if C and B do not each list the other.
- Program C cannot sit on the file if it shares an exclusive group other than none with A or with B.
- With C added the file would carry 3 credits in reserved, verified or applied status, which the ceiling permits; a fourth credit would exceed it.
- A credit of program A that has expired, been forfeited or been revoked is not among the credits read together, and does not occupy one of the 3 places or the one place per program.
- A second credit of program A cannot be reserved on the file while the first stands reserved, verified or applied.

### Order of payment (hypothetical)

Concessions of 3000.00 are recorded on a file and two credits sit on it, one with application position 2 and one with position 5. The concessions cover the borrower's costs first, then the position-2 credit, then the position-5 credit; neither credit pays a cost the concessions have already paid, and concessions and credits together never exceed the borrower's total closing costs, prepaid items and, where allowed, down payment. If the position-5 credit is one whose listed categories run nonrecurring closing costs first and prepaid items second, and 600.00 of nonrecurring closing costs is still unpaid when its turn comes, it places at most 600.00 there before anything goes to prepaid items.

superseded_clauses: each filling its applicable_cost_categories in the listed order up to the cost still unpaid in that category
